definition_de: seinen Namen mit der Hand unter ein Dokument schreiben, um zuzustimmen (einen Vertrag, ein Formular unterschreiben); übertragen: Das kann ich unterschreiben = dem stimme ich zu
example_de: Nachdem wir die Wohnung besichtigt hatten, haben wir sofort den Mietvertrag unterschrieben.
example_en: After we had viewed the flat, we signed the rental contract right away.
visual_idea: Most typical collocation 'einen (Miet-)Vertrag unterschreiben': a happy couple in an empty Altbau flat signing on a windowsill while the landlord holds out the keys; the keys + empty flat make the contract a rental one. The document is shown at a flat angle so it reads as blank paper (documents attract fake text). Signing a friend's plaster cast was more fun but less everyday.
image_prompt: an empty sunny Altbau apartment with high white walls, tall windows and a wooden parquet floor, a young couple stands at the broad windowsill, the woman bends over a few white sheets of paper lying flat and signs with a pen while her partner smiles, an older landlord beside them holds out a bunch of apartment keys, the paper seen at a shallow angle so it looks plain white
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: in an empty sunny Altbau apartment a young woman signs a sheet of paper on the windowsill with one smooth stroke of her pen, straightens up smiling, and the landlord hands the keys to her partner; static medium shot
